description: Navigate a tab to a URL and wait for the page to load. Like a browser, a network failure or an empty HTTP error response leaves Chromium's error page in the tab and is reported in `error` rather than failing the call. Element refs from earlier snapshots are invalidated by navigation.

timeout_ms.description: Upper bound on the navigation wait; clamped to `max_timeout_ms`.

url.description: Absolute URL; scheme must be on the configured allowlist.

error.description: Chromium's error text when the navigation ended on the browser's own error page: a network failure (`net::ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED`), or an empty HTTP error response (`net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE`, a 4xx/5xx with no body). Like a browser, the tab still shows that page and stays usable.

ok.description: False when the tab shows Chromium's error page instead of the site; see `error`.

timed_out.description: True when the load event did not fire inside the timeout; the page may still be usable; snapshot to check.
